body:
Hello Alberto, when editing a photo I generate Snapshots for each version, but if I go to "Processing profile operations" and "clear", the Snapshots disappear. Is there any method that warns that those Snapshots are going to be deleted?.
What I do at the moment is generate a Snapshot of the original photo before I start editing, and then I keep making the others according to the versions, and that way I don't use the "clear" option.
